prior_findings: R1 (minor, session_readout.access.owner_unavailable.title): APPLIED AS PROPOSED — on disk «Доступ через {owner} недоступен»; renders «Доступ через Mac mini Дамиана недоступен» and «Доступ через устройство-владелец недоступен», so the lowercase-at-title-start symptom N3 raised is gone on the ru side even though N3's code-side fix remains open (it still affects the other locales' {owner}-initial titles).

R2 / N5 (nit, effort.level.max + effort.level.xhigh): NOT APPLIED, deliberately — R2 asked for a rendered-chip measurement before any change, and the labels are unchanged; recorded here as nit S3D-R1 with the measured ratios, still requiring a rendered check rather than a copy change.

R3 (nit, ask_queue.duration.days): APPLIED AS PROPOSED — «{count, number} дн.»; checked against shipped precedent, which is the same mixed convention (presence.days_ago «дн. назад», presence.hours_ago «ч назад», presence.minutes_ago «мин назад»), so days-with-period plus hours/minutes/seconds-without is shipped practice, not a new inconsistency.

R4 (nit, credential_notice.armed): APPLIED AS PROPOSED — «ожидает ввода — поставьте пробел, затем введите или вставьте секрет»; reads as ready-and-waiting, keeps the lowercase status register and the list of actions.

R5 (nit, aside.adopt.refused.turn_running): APPLIED AS PROPOSED — «…Добавьте вопрос, когда ответ завершится.»; the singular noun now has an antecedent, and the sentence still fits between the two status sentences of its tone.

N1 (minor, draft.confirm_model_effort): APPLIED WITH A DISCLOSED DEVIATION — N1 asked for the dash clause «уровень рассуждений — {effort}», the final bytes say «глубина рассуждений — {effort}»; N2 separately required unifying the term on «глубина рассуждений», so taking N1's dash shape with N2's noun is the correct consolidation, and the nominative label after the dash still avoids N1's instrumental case disagreement.

N2 (minor, reasoning-effort glossary): APPLIED — «глубина рассуждений» now appears in confirm_effort_changed, confirm_effort_unset, confirm_model_effort, detail.not_reported, detail.no_levels, detail.offers, detail.session and strip.effort_aria, matching shipped ui.chat.pickers.effort.title and ui.miniView.sheet_effort; «уровни рассуждений» is kept only where the plural noun 'levels' is meant (detail.default_only, refusal_ladder_unread), which is the distinction N2 drew.

N4 (nit, access.expired.description) and Q2 (nit, rail.close/open): REJECTED-WITH-REASON, judged sound — N4's parenthetical «у владельца ({owner})» is the only shape that avoids demanding a genitive of a caller-supplied device name, and reads redundantly only with the fallback phrase; Q2's «Закрыть панель запросов» vs «Открыть запросы» mirrors shipped ui.chat.asks.close_asks and composer.secret_ask_open exactly. Both verified unchanged in the final bytes.

Q1 (minor, ask_queue.refusal.expired), A1 (nit, continuation_escape), A2 (nit, declined_options), N6 (nit, strip.readings_dropped): APPLIED AND VERIFIED — «Срок этого запроса истёк, ответить на него уже нельзя — спросите агента ещё раз.», round brackets around «(этот обмен будет отброшен)», «отбросить этот обмен», «Показания сброшены при потере соединения.»
observations: PR completeness, not a translation defect: scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs is modified but UNCOMMITTED, and its added IDENTICAL_OK rows are what make the stub test pass on this tree. Measured, not assumed: across the 21 composer namespaces 33 ru values are byte-identical to English, and 4 of them are covered only by the working-tree table, not by HEAD - ui.chat.ask_queue.deadline.with_subject (in this audited set), ui.chat.ask_answer.unconfirmed, ui.chat.session_spend.summary.basis_amount and ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.chip. allowsIdenticalValue() is a pure table lookup with no placeholder exemption, so without that file in the commit the stub test fails on all four. The catalogue bytes are fine; the test change must ride with them.

«Глубина рассуждений: {level}» with a masculine level label (высокий/Максимальный) looks like a gender mismatch but is shipped practice: ui.chat.pickers.destination_pickers.effort_for_this_conversation already renders «Глубина рассуждений для этого разговора: {value}», and the label set is heterogeneous (Авто, Нет, неизвестно, Очень высокий) so no single adjective could agree. Not a defect; no change proposed.

access.owner_fallback «устройство-владелец» is an invariant compound spliced into nominative, accusative and parenthetical slots; it renders acceptably in all of them because the head noun «устройство» is neuter and its accusative equals the nominative. Recorded so nobody later 'fixes' one slot into a genitive.

ui.chat.credential_notice.unredacted's other branch «# символа стали» would govern a fractional count (1,5 символа стали rather than the prescriptive 1,5 символа стало), but the argument is a character count and therefore always an integer, so the branch is unreachable; the reachable categories (one/few/many) all agree correctly.

Length: the three widest ru overruns in this set are duration.unknown 7->15 («некоторое время», a two-word phrase substituted into «истекает через …»), strip.fast_mode_on 12->21 and access.history.last_resolved 22->38; all three sit in prose or a detail line, and the sidecars declare no length budget for them, so no shorter phrasing is proposed.

The repo's own locale-parity run happened in this worktree with the manager's uncommitted test change present, and with node_modules being the shared symlink to the primary checkout; no dependency was installed and no file in the repository outside this receipt was written (the helper scripts live in the session scratchpad).
